parse.title: Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)
parse.text:
Meta Unit
This unit is one of the most effective units in the game!
Meta Support Unit
This unit has one of the BEST supporting abilities in-game!

Overview

Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is obtained by evolving Shadow Sorcerer (Incident).

Evolving

Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) can be evolved from Shadow Sorcerer (Incident) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Shadow Sorcerer (Incident)
x200 Sacred Treasure
x1 Sacred Treasure (Adapted)
Result
Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Ritual

Upon being maxed Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) will gain the ability to delete itself in return for summoning Divine General.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) is a meta support due to his ability to summon Divine General rather than his curse effect
  • Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) has a 100% chance to apply Curse.
  • Only one Divine General can be summoned from each player, meaning that Ritual won't function if you try to use it if one has already been summoned.
  • It is recommended to get unique on Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) as it allows you to place another down after you have summoned Divine General on a fully maxed out Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual), also allowing them both to increase dps significantly.
